# EvoTek Innovations
> EvoTek Innovations is a London-based company pioneering Smart Surface Technology (SST) — a physics-based, non-biocidal antimicrobial surface coating providing up to 336 hours of continuous protection. NHS supply partner. ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified. Based at 3rd Floor, 86-90 Paul Street, London EC2A 4PB.

## Business

EvoTek Innovations is a London-based surface technology company. Its core product is Smart Surface Technology (SST) — a physics-based, non-biocidal platform grounded in biomimicry and Engineered Surface Physics (ESP). SST replicates micro-textures found in nature (shark skin, lotus leaf, gecko feet, dragonfly wings) to prevent bacteria, viruses, fungi, mould, and odour from adhering to any substrate.

## Key Facts

- Protection duration: up to 336 hours (14 days) per application
- Coverage: 140 m² per litre
- Drying time: 5–8 minutes
- Non-toxic, food-safe, biodegradable (EC 648/2004 compliant)
- WHO recognised technology
- NHS Supply Partner
- ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified
- EN 14476 compliant
- No chemicals or biocides released — physics-based mechanism only
- Compatible with normal cleaning regimes
- Applies to all substrates: plastics, metals, fabrics, porous surfaces

## Services

- Smart Surface Technology (SST) — antimicrobial surface protection
- Engineered Surface Physics (ESP) — biomimicry-based surface engineering platform
- Antimicrobial surface treatment (336-hour, non-toxic, food-safe, biodegradable)
